dedupe_keys.name: air cargo transport network actn dataset

description: The Air Cargo Transport Network (ACTN) dataset, published by Delft University of Technology researchers on 4TU.ResearchData in January 2020, describes the worldwide air cargo network. It contains a set of airports worldwide that are relevant for global air cargo transport; aircraft-specific yearly flight frequencies for 2014 for all passenger and cargo airlines, excluding integrators, on every origin-destination airport pair; and, for each of the integrators FedEx, UPS and DHL, estimated yearly cargo capacity in tonnes for 2019 on every origin-destination pair, derived from recorded flights filtered to those operated by the integrators. Coverage is global. The data are available to download as a single compressed 7z archive of about 1.1 MB, free under the MIT licence. Caveats: the frequencies refer to 2014 and the integrator capacities to 2019, so the network is a snapshot, and integrator capacities are estimates. The network suits network flow, capacity planning and cascading failure studies of global air freight, for example removing hub airports under hazards. It complements OpenFlights and the ACI airport traffic data.
name: Air Cargo Transport Network (ACTN) dataset
